historical_references.reference: Jadrian, a Roman martyr, is believed to have lived during the persecution of Emperor Decius (249-251 AD). He was a deacon who refused to sacrifice to Roman gods and was executed for his faith.

Another Saint Jadrian is recorded in the Latin Martyrology for the 23rd of April. He was a priest of the diocese of Cagliari in Sardinia. He was martyred during the persecution of Emperor Diocletian (284-305 AD) when he refused to abandon Christianity.
